### F-115 — A test-only roleBit silently overwrote the Admin role row

> _2026-08-21 · realm/blong-core · resolved_

The blong-access test seed (`meta/dbTest/accessAuthorizationMerge.yaml`) creates the test-only
`NoLogin` role through `accessAuthorizationMerge`, which hardcodes `extraColumns: {roleBit: 0}`.
`access_role` has `UNIQUE KEY access_role_ux_roleBit(roleBit)`, and `coreResourceEnsure`
(`realm/blong-core/adapter/db/coreResourceEnsure.ts`) inserted the entity row with
`.onConflict(keyName).merge()` — MySQL `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`, which fires on ANY unique-key
conflict — so the `NoLogin` insert overwrote the existing `Admin` row (also roleBit 0), removing
Admin from `access_role` while its `core_resource` row survived.

Tests that join `access_role` (`accessAuthorizationList`, `accessProfileGet`, and gateway's authz /
kopi's HTTP auth) then failed, while login passed because it reads the materialized `core_path`. On
the second run the prod seed `1-accessRoleMerge.yaml` re-inserted Admin (roleBit 0, overwriting
NoLogin's row back), so tests passed — 'first run fails, second succeeds'. Fix: pre-seed `NoLogin`
with a free `roleBit: 5` in `meta/db/1-accessRoleMerge.yaml` (the documented 'pre-seed roles' rule),
and harden `coreResourceEnsure` to use `.onConflict(keyName).ignore()` (`INSERT IGNORE`) so a
secondary unique-key conflict can never clobber an existing row. Debug technique that worked:
reproduce on a fresh database, then query `access_role`/`core_resource` mid-run — the missing Admin
row plus NoLogin owning bit 0 was the smoking gun.
